The accepted [character relationship design](../archive/03-design-proposals/agents-and-social-simulation.md#social-continuity) separates structured objective facts such as blood relations from unstructured person-to-free-text assessments such as “friend,” “good friend,” or “lover.” Each person may freely revise their own assessment at any point based on memories and perception, without relationship points, thresholds or a fixed progression. Assessments are sparse and directional; they cannot rewrite another person's view or objective kinship. Revisioned actor-owned subject-note editing and atomic reflection publication are already delivered through [Knowledge](knowledge.md); richer social interfaces and integrated behavioral qualification remain with their focused owners.
Conversation preserves speaker, actual per-turn audience, interruption and topic continuity. Characters can decline, respond only through a gesture or private thought, keep working while talking, ask clarifying questions and return to unfinished plans. A promise and its fulfillment are distinct events; exhausting inference allowance must not erase accepted obligations. The delivered finite [conversation lifecycle](narration-and-conversations.md#6-durable-conversation-lifecycle) supports changing membership, overhearing without joining, self-talk and atomic merges; the NC tracker retains broader conversation, voice and behavioral qualification. Membership never grants earlier speech awareness. One-on-one text precedes group text and voice, with captions retained for accessibility.
Learning can follow observation, testimony, teaching and actual practice without a research minigame. Seeing part of a method cannot reveal hidden steps; proficiency changes require native evidence. Learned technique identity and supported live definition revisions retain their separate integrity requirements, while genuinely new steps must be learned. This is not support for obsolete code or save layouts under the [development policy](../AGENTS.md#development-save-policy).
There are three immediate execution paths: level 0 runs installed native routines, bodily consequences, urgent responses and valid ongoing plan steps with zero model calls; level 1 lets Jev select a fully specified supplied action for normal engine admission and native execution, without a generative LLM; levels 2–4 generate speech, new thoughts, goal revisions, replanning, unlisted attempts or invention proposals when supplied choices cannot express the needed response. A feasible action does not suppress an independently warranted conversational or planning response. Level-5 reflection remains independent, neither a prerequisite nor an automatic consequence of a simple action selection. These native guarantees do not recreate automatic human food seeking or eating: the [bundled survival policy](worlds/base/survival.md#bodily-conditions-and-chosen-responses) leaves those choices to cognition even when a person carries food. Every level-1 decision ends in one explicit outcome: act on the selected binding, deliberately continue, escalate once to an offered generative level through the normal spending allowance, or defer with its reason.
Quantifiable actor-permitted facts retain their measured values, units and scale rather than being replaced by qualitative prose. Body context includes each available numeric attribute at its current value and declared range; concerns supplement that measurement. In the bundled world, the food meter is fullness (lower means hungrier), not a hunger score; other worlds choose their own attributes and meanings. Unknown values remain explicitly unknown; do not invent numbers for qualitative feelings or expose another actor’s private measurements.
The Mike/Ada examples use the [bundled starting world](worlds/base/survival.md#embodied-survival-and-authored-start), not an engine-required character name. Agent-facing memories and context must refer to people by known names, never by the gameplay role “player.” Unknown people remain unidentified rather than gaining a name the observer does not know. Preserve quoted dialogue verbatim, with the speaker attributed outside the quote; the memory owner's own speech can be attributed as “I said: …”.
**Importance and urgency are separate bounded event-time scores.** Importance measures lasting significance for retention, attention and later reflection. Urgency measures how quickly newly perceived evidence should supersede an immediate response already in flight. An important event need not be urgent: learning that a close friend is visiting may matter greatly without requiring the current sentence to be discarded. Ordinary speech and routine awareness likewise do not invalidate a response merely because they arrived later. The current event and awareness types permit an absent urgency value; the in-flight interruption check treats that absence as nonurgent. This is the optional current-record contract, not a requirement to retain a legacy reader or infer urgency from importance.
Current PostgreSQL storage already includes actor-scoped awareness, memories, summaries and accepted inner-world text/files. The [canonical record tree](../apps/server/src/world-record-schema.ts) owns their current physical tables and indexes; the [production data contract](../archive/07-technical-architecture/production-data-model.md#8-minds-evidence-knowledge-and-conversation) retains broader query and hosted-scope targets. Storage changes follow the [development save policy](../AGENTS.md#development-save-policy); delivered records are not a missing schema project.
PostgreSQL is the current shared store; records are scoped by world and actor. A persistent actor workspace is the authoring surface for inner-world text, not a second simulation database.
World commits and awareness delivery must be recoverable together; duplicate delivery must not create duplicate experiences. Game time drives age, recall windows, sleep and reminders; real time drives service deadlines, queue limits and spending. Store enough clock information to interpret saved game times after restart. The canonical record tree supplies the current physical table/index layout; the production data model preserves the semantic responsibilities and remaining delivery requirements.
Reflection changes files through scoped workspace capabilities. Its final response already requires **1–3 short presentation thoughts, each no more than 20 words and 240 characters**, enforced by the current reflection schema; [LA021](limits/memory.md#la021) tracks that presentation choice separately from the complete private reflection. These are authored character narration for the game, not provider private deliberation. It must not echo the entire edited inner world or its database metadata in JSON. Invalid output/publication preserves the previous accepted state; there is no automatic paid repair.
The [CR01–CR12 build tasks](maintainers/cognition-redesign.md) retain the dependency sequence and remaining acceptance for delivered compact context, immediate conversation, awareness/recall, hourly cleanup, editable workspaces, background reflection, configured sleep/triggers and inspection. Reuse those implementations rather than restarting the sequence. Current-format validation, same-version continuation and supported live-definition changes preserve integrity; old-development-save imports are not a delivery requirement. The task list is execution tracking, not a second architecture specification.
- Sleep follows the installed world policy, dreams cannot run before its configured continuous-sleep threshold, and provider failure never blocks admitted native sleep or bodily consequences. This does not guarantee that a cognitive actor chooses or obtains food.
files.summary: reconcile delivered memory owners, current record contracts and native survival guarantees
